name: BookingLive
description_en:
BookingLive provides configurable booking software for appointments, courses, events and resources. Its current enterprise positioning emphasizes government and healthcare services, where a booking journey can include customer information, payment, notifications and resource availability.

The central decision is the implementation scope: what citizens or customers book, what staff administer, and which systems exchange information. Enterprise and the smaller Connect offering have different commercial boundaries. This profile covers the enterprise platform; a reference to Connect on the same website does not make enterprise features free.
description_zh:
BookingLive 提供可配置的预约软件，管理预约、课程、活动与资源。官网当前的企业定位侧重政府和医疗服务，预约流程可以涉及客户资料、付款、通知及资源可用性。

选型重点是实施范围：公众或客户预约什么，员工管理什么，以及哪些系统需要交换数据。Enterprise 与面向较小需求的 Connect 有不同商业边界。本文介绍企业平台；同一官网提到 Connect，不表示企业功能免费。

sections.en:
For a council workshop, define a dated course, available places and the attendee information staff need. A customer selects an available session, provides the required details, and pays if the offer requires payment. Staff need a matching booking record, while the customer needs a confirmation and an appropriate reminder. This is an editorial example derived from the documented booking types, not a deployed council implementation.

Before procurement, demonstrate a full session, a cancellation and a changed attendee detail. Check whether the public portal and staff view agree after each action. An attractive form alone does not establish that capacity, refunds and downstream records remain consistent.
sections.zh:
以市政工作坊为例，先定义课程日期、名额及员工所需的参与者资料。客户选择可用场次、填写资料；收费项目还需付款。员工应能看到对应预约，客户应收到确认和适当提醒。这是依据已记载预约类型设计的编辑示例，未经实际部署。

采购前应演示满员、取消和修改参与者资料三种情况，逐次核对公众门户与后台是否一致。表单外观本身不能证明名额、退款和下游记录保持一致。

sections.title_zh: 集成需要约定数据方向
sections.en:
The integration page describes calendar additions, gateways such as Stripe and PayPal, application connections through Zapier, and an enterprise API. Its Zoom description explicitly refers to a Zapier custom feature. Treat these as different connection mechanisms with their own setup and access requirements.

Specify which system owns the booking identifier and which changes must propagate. Ask the vendor to demonstrate a booking update and a failed destination call with your intended integration. The public overview does not establish universal two-way conflict resolution or a retry guarantee.
sections.zh:
集成页面介绍日历添加、Stripe 和 PayPal 等支付网关、经 Zapier 连接应用及企业 API。Zoom 说明明确涉及 Zapier 自定义功能。这些连接方式不同，各有配置与访问要求。

应指定哪个系统保存预约标识，以及哪些修改必须同步。要求厂商用计划采用的集成演示预约修改及目标调用失败。公开概述并不能证明通用双向冲突处理或重试保证。

sections.title_en: Annual base, optional modules and usage
sections.en:
The pricing page lists enterprise entry pricing from £7,500 a year, including implementation and support, then offers a tailored quote after scoping. Its FAQ states a minimum two-year contract and first-year payment at signing. The annual starting figure is therefore neither a cancellable monthly subscription nor a complete procurement total.

The page separately prices white label, extensions, multisite, SMS and hosting tiers. Basic hosting includes up to 12,000 bookings per year; higher volume or concurrency can require a higher tier. Enterprise adds no platform transaction fee according to the FAQ, but gateway or merchant-bank fees can still apply. Budget from the actual booking volume, integrations, hosting and contract, rather than dividing the starting annual amount by twelve.
sections.zh:
定价页列出 Enterprise 每年 £7,500 起，包含实施与支持，并在需求界定后提供具体报价。FAQ 写明最低两年合同，签署时支付第一年费用。因此，年费起价既不是可按月取消的订阅，也不是完整采购总额。

页面另外列出白标、扩展、多站点、短信及托管层级费用。基础托管每年最多包含 12,000 次预约；更高用量或并发可能要求升级。FAQ 表示 Enterprise 不额外收平台交易费，但网关或收单银行仍可能收费。预算应依据实际预约量、集成、托管和合同，而非只把起始年费除以十二。

sections.en:
The enterprise terms tie delivery to an agreed statement of work and describe customer acceptance tests. They also make customer collaboration a dependency: delayed inputs can delay delivery or add cost. Bring representative booking data, role requirements and integration requirements to the scope discussion.

For faults, the terms request the circumstances and supporting information so the vendor can investigate. They exclude certain causes such as unsuitable browsers or data integrity problems from vendor responsibility. No recovery exercise was performed here. Obtain the applicable support tier, incident route and restoration obligations in the actual agreement.
sections.zh:
企业条款将交付与约定的工作说明书关联，并描述客户验收测试。客户配合也是依赖条件：输入延迟可能导致交付延后或增加成本。需求讨论时应准备代表性预约数据、角色要求及集成要求。

故障方面，条款要求说明发生条件并提供辅助资料，供厂商调查；不合适的浏览器或数据完整性等部分原因不属于厂商责任。本文未执行恢复演练。实际协议中应明确适用支持层级、事故联系路径和恢复义务。

sections.en:
A service owner coordinating several booking types and departments has reasons to investigate the configuration and implementation service. A buyer who only needs a lightweight meeting link should first examine whether that procurement scope is proportionate. BookingLive explicitly says its solutions do not cover restaurants and accommodation; a generic reservations label from a directory should not override that boundary.

The terms grant specified use under a non-exclusive licence and retain the vendor’s software intellectual property. Browser access and managed hosting do not confer open-source redistribution rights. Source escrow is separately advertised on the pricing page and should not be confused with an open-source release.
sections.zh:
需要协调多种预约和多个部门的服务负责人，可以重点考察配置及实施服务。只需要简单会议链接的买家，应先判断这一采购范围是否适度。BookingLive 明确表示不提供餐厅和住宿方案；第三方目录中的通用预订标签不能覆盖该边界。

条款按指定用途授予非独占使用许可，软件知识产权保留在厂商。浏览器访问和托管服务不赋予开源再分发权。定价页另列源码托管服务，不应把它当作开源发布。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: No tenant, payment, cancellation, integration retry or restoration test was performed; final support and regional processing terms remain contract-specific.
research_gaps.zh: 未测试租户、付款、取消、集成重试或恢复；最终支持与地区处理条件取决于合同。

research_gaps.en: Homepage adoption and volume figures are inconsistent across page blocks and are omitted. Connect entitlements were not researched as enterprise entitlements.
research_gaps.zh: 首页不同区块的采用与用量数字不一致，本文未采用；未把 Connect 权益当作 Enterprise 权益。
